description: Opus X unit B3 (refused by the engine): the only way to an active 0-HP Pokemon with switchFlag === true. Golisopod (Emergency Exit, 76/150 HP) Head Smashes Weak Armor Chansey (Eject Pack): Weak Armor's Defense drop sets the pack's eject flag; the recoil knocks Golisopod out (faint() clears its switchFlag) and then runEvent('EmergencyExit'), which has no HP guard after recoil, flags it again. At AfterMove Chansey's pack sees Golisopod's switchFlag === true through getAllActive() (the faint is not processed yet) and stays; Showdown then asks p1 to replace the fainted Golisopod mid-turn, and the pack is used when the replacement switches in.
